newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HODDLE COMPLAINS ABOUT STATE OF PITCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HODDLE COMPLAINS ABOUT STATE OF PITCH.

text.p: Coach Glenn Hoddle has complained about the state of the pitch for England's World Cup qualifier against Georgia on Saturday.

Hoddle, who has asked for the heavy roller to be used on the surface at the Boris Paichaidze Stadium in Tbilisi, said on Thursday: "The pitch looks worse than Moldova. But it won't suit Georgia either because they are a very technical side.
"There are patches all over the pitch, which is bare and brown in parts."
